fieldData.full-article-text:
On your Chrome browser, go to dashboard.radixdlt.com.

In the top right-hand corner of the dashboard, click Connect and login to the Radix dashboard. 

You will now receive a Login request in the mobile wallet. Choose or create a Persona to log in with. 

Once you have selected the Persona, click Continue and review the account permissions page in the app. 

Select the account(s) that you would like to log in with and then press Continue. 

Once complete, the Dashboard’s Connect button will show you the Persona, data permissions, and account details that you are logged in with

To review an account's transaction history, copy the account details that you wish to review. 

Paste the account details into the dashboard search bar, press enter, and you will now see an account overview with the subsections:  Tokens, NFTs, Pool units, Recent, and Metadata.

Click Recent transactions

‍You are now able to review the Account's recent transactions.
fieldData.name: How to View Your Transaction History
